storyLines: Hello, aren't you one of my Jain's students?
You should be proud of yourself,
since the school is full of great students and faculty members...
No school uniform, no name tag...
Oh, you're a NEW STUDENT? Oh, my...
^<font=CROOKED>^There are no exceptions even for a NEW STUDENT.^</font>^
^<font=CROOKED>^Well, I do love all of our students equally,^</font>^
So where were we? Right, about our school ...
